fixes.was: For diversity purposes a natural person is a citizen of the state of domicile, which persists until the person takes up residence elsewhere with the intention to remain there,
fixes.now: For diversity purposes a natural person is a citizen of a state only if a United States citizen domiciled there; domicile persists until the person takes up residence elsewhere intending to remain,
